metadata.description:
A towering tribute to flour power, the Gold Medal Flour sign atop the old Washburn A Mill shines over the riverfront like a neon ghost of the city’s milling past. What was once the world’s largest flour mill is now the award-winning Mill City Museum, blending industrial grit with modern storytelling. The illuminated sign has seen it all—from roaring waterwheels to bustling farmers markets. You’ve earned this Minneapolis Marvel POAP for honoring the grain that built the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Minneapolis Marvel 
GPS: 44.97888, -93.25634 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97888,-93.25634
